name: jira
description: Access Jira to manage issues, add comments, and update ticket status. Token is read securely from local file.

tools.name: list_my_issues
tools.description: List issues assigned to me that are not done/closed.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a Jira issue.

tools.name: transition_issue
tools.description: Change the status of a Jira issue (e.g., To Do -> In Progress -> In Review -> Done).
